requirement.description: Missing IOPort class definition. Tests fail with NameError: name 'IOPort' is not defined because the IOPort class is not implemented or imported in the hdl module. Multiple test cases reference IOPort constructor and methods.
requirement.contract: Add the IOPort class definition to the hdl/_ast.py module with proper constructor, attributes (attrs, metadata), and methods (_ioports()). The class should accept width, name, attrs, and metadata parameters and behave according to test expectations.

requirement.description: Missing Direction class definition. Tests fail with NameError: name 'Direction' is not defined because the Direction class is not implemented or imported in the hdl module. Test cases reference Direction operations like OR and AND.
requirement.contract: Add the Direction class definition to the hdl/_ast.py module with proper bitwise operations support (OR, AND) to satisfy test expectations.

requirement.description: Missing from_bits method on StructLayout. Tests fail with AttributeError: type object 'a' has no attribute 'from_bits' because the from_bits method is not implemented on the StructLayout class.
requirement.contract: Add the from_bits method to the StructLayout class in lib/data.py to support conversion from bits to structured data.

requirement.description: Incorrect error message formatting in View class. Tests fail due to mismatched error messages for validation scenarios like array layout indexing, attribute conflicts, and layout validation.
requirement.contract: Update error message formatting in the View class to match expected formats exactly for various validation scenarios including array layout indexing, attribute conflicts, and layout validation errors.

requirement.description: PureInterface missing memory attribute. Tests fail with AttributeError: 'PureInterface' object has no attribute 'memory' because the memory attribute is not implemented on the PureInterface class.
requirement.contract: Add the memory attribute to the PureInterface class in lib/memory.py to satisfy test expectations.
